title: Agent Allowlist Framework: list document
description: What a list is and how it is run. A list that leaves a question open states that the matter is not used

management.description: Who maintains the list and how that authority is held

authority.description: For instance: a single account, a multi-signature account, a collective decision of a named body

decisionRecord.description: Where decisions about the list are recorded

scopeDocument.description: documentHash of the scope the list is published for

designation.description: Whether the manager's own choice is a sufficient ground for an entry

criteriaDocument.description: documentHash of the criteria the list applies

source.description: DERIVED: the source list, and whether the list follows it or holds to one state of it

noticePeriod.description: Seconds between adding an entry and its earliest effect

review.description: When entries are looked at again

dueProcess.description: Notice, objection and appeal. Each is optional; a list that offers none says so

effectDuringObjection.description: Whether an entry has effect while an objection is open

set.description: COMMITTED: what the committed set is

disclosure.description: Who can obtain proofs and what a proof reveals
